senses.gloss:
ईश ईश् + अ, m., f. शा,
 1. A proprietor, Pañc. i. d. 16.
 2. A master, MBh. 1, 1532.
 3. A ruler, Man. 9, 245.
 4. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 588.
 --Comp.

ईशा ईश् + आ (also ईषा ईषा), f. The pole of a car, Rām. 6, 69, 46.
 --Comp.

ईशान ईश् + आन (properly the ptcple. of the pres.),
 I. adj. Ruling, Chr. 293, 4 [] = Rigv. i. 87, 4.
 II. m. A name of Śiva, MBh. 3, 8169.
 III. f. नी, A surname of Durgā, Dev. 8, 21.
 --Comp.
ईशानकृत् ईशान-कृ + त्, adj. Behaving as master, Chr. 290, 5 = Rigv. i. 64, 5.

ईषत् ईषत् (probably ntr. of the ptcple. of the present of ईक्ष्, with ष् for क्ष्), adv.
 1. A little, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 18.
 2. When the former part of a comp., especially when followed by a word denoting the partic. of the fut. pass.: Easily, e. g. ईषत्-कार्य (vb. कृ), Easy to be made, Rām. 4, 54, 12 (विदारणे, easy to be cleft).
 ईषत्-कर (vb. कृ), Easy to be performed, Prab. 36, 6.
ईशा- + दन्त ईशा- + दन्त, or ईषा-, adj. having tusks like the pole of a carriage (i. e. an elephant), Rām. 5, 12, 31; MBh. 2, 1877.
